name: update_ticket
description: Update an existing Zoho Desk ticket with the customer's issue description. Call this AFTER the customer has explained their problem. The ticket_id must come from either create_ticket response (ticket_id field) or from authenticate_customer response (ticket_details.zoho_id field).

request_body_schema.description: Request body for updating a ticket

properties.description: The Zoho internal ticket ID. Get this from create_ticket.ticket_id OR from authenticate_customer.ticket_details.zoho_id.
Customer's full issue description to be saved in the ticket. Include product name, issue details, and any relevant info the customer mentioned.
Ticket status. Use Open for active issues, Closed if resolved on the call.
